name: agent-observability
description: Privacy-first local view of GitHub Copilot agent telemetry. Raw data stays on your machine; only opt-in aggregates are ever shared.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Local Overview will summarize your GitHub Copilot agent activity from the on-disk telemetry database.

Local telemetry reading arrives in a later phase. Nothing is read or uploaded yet.

[Open Settings](command:agentObservability.openSettings)

Sessions will list your local Copilot agent sessions with prompt, tool, model, duration and success detail.

Session browsing arrives in a later phase. All session detail stays on this machine.

[Refresh](command:agentObservability.refresh)

Sync uploads only opt-in, aggregated, non-sensitive statistics to your organization dashboard. Raw prompts, completions, tool I/O, source-file paths and file contents never leave your machine.

When enabled, the only paths shared are repository-relative paths of customization files (instructions, skills, prompts, agents, hooks) — with counts, never contents — so your team can review context-engineering hotspots.

Cloud sharing is OFF by default.

[Set Organization API Key](command:agentObservability.setApiKey)
[Open Settings](command:agentObservability.openSettings)

chatParticipants.name: obs
chatParticipants.description: Open a local agent session-detail view (@obs, or @obs <id or title>)

agentObservability.sync.enabled.markdownDescription: Opt in to share aggregated, non-sensitive statistics with your organization dashboard. Disabled by default (opt-out). Raw prompts, completions, and tool input/output are never uploaded, and neither are source- or document-file paths or any file contents. The only paths shared are repository-relative paths of customization files (instructions, skills, prompts, agents, hooks), sent with counts so your team can review context-engineering hotspots during sprint retrospectives.

agentObservability.sync.intervalMinutes.markdownDescription: How often background sync uploads aggregate batches, in minutes. Minimum 5.

agentObservability.localTelemetry.enable.markdownDescription: Feature flag to enable the local telemetry view. When disabled, the extension does not read the local Copilot telemetry database.

agentObservability.sqlitePath.markdownDescription: Override the path to the Copilot `agent-traces.db` SQLite database. Leave blank to auto-detect — auto-detection finds and MERGES every reachable database, so agent logs from both Windows and WSL appear together regardless of which environment the window runs in: on the Windows host the installed distros are scanned over `\\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...` in addition to the local `%APPDATA%` database, and inside a Remote-WSL window the `~/.vscode-server/data` location is checked alongside the Windows host's databases via `/mnt/c/Users/...`. Set this explicitly (e.g. `\\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\me\.vscode-server\data\User\globalStorage\github.copilot-chat\agent-traces.db`) to pin a SINGLE database and disable merging.

agentObservability.deviation.maxSessionM.markdownDescription: Maximum expected duration of an agent session, in minutes, used by the local workflow-deviation detector to flag overlong sessions (TimeoutExceeded) when no explicit workflow is configured for the repository.

agentObservability.deviation.notifyOnDiv.markdownDescription: Show a VS Code notification when a configured workflow diverges within a user-request turn (a step is skipped or runs out of order). Off by default; per-turn divergences are always shown inline in the session-detail timeline regardless.

agentObservability.context.acceptedMissi.markdownDescription: Context file names that are accepted as missing. Files in this list will not appear in the "Expected but missing" section of the Context Analysis tab.
Source file names whose outgoing missing references should be suppressed. When a source file is listed here, any files referenced only by it will not appear in the "Expected but missing" section.

agentObservability.workflows.markdownDescription: Optional per-repository expected agent workflows for the local deviation detector. When a repository has an explicit entry here, sequence and missing-step checks are enabled in addition to the always-on timeout and failure-rate checks. All detection runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

repository.markdownDescription: Sanitized repository this configuration applies to (e.g. `https://github.com/org/repo`).

workflows.markdownDescription: Expected workflows to check this repository's sessions against.

expectedSequence.markdownDescription: Expected ordered agent names. When present, enables sequence and missing-step checks.

maxDurationMinutes.markdownDescription: Maximum expected workflow duration, in minutes. Defaults to `agentObservability.deviation.maxSessionMinutes` when omitted.

sequenceDeviationAlert.markdownDescription: Flag sequence and missing-step deviations. Requires `expectedSequence`.

timeoutExceededAlert.markdownDescription: Flag sessions that exceed the maximum duration.

toolUsageAnomalyAlert.markdownDescription: Flag sessions with a high (>50% over >=3 interactions) failure rate.

triggerPredicate.markdownDescription: Optional metadata filter scoping which interactions belong to this workflow (the local equivalent of the cloud `TriggerKqlQuery`). When set, every check runs over only the matching interactions. All fields are optional; an absent field matches any value; string fields compare case-insensitively.

toolName.markdownDescription: Match the tool name; interactions without a tool never match.

steps.markdownDescription: Optional ordered, structured workflow steps. When present, predicate-based matching supersedes `expectedSequence` for the sequence and missing-step checks: each step must match at least one in-scope interaction, in order. All matching runs locally.

name.markdownDescription: Step name, shown in deviation descriptions.

predicate.markdownDescription: Metadata filter the step must match. All fields optional; an absent field matches any value; string fields compare case-insensitively.

toolName.markdownDescription: Match the tool name; interactions without a tool never match.

contentPredicate.markdownDescription: **Local-only** content condition over a raw span attribute. Evaluated entirely on this machine; the matched text NEVER leaves it and any deviation it produces is marked local-only and excluded from sync by construction. Requires one of `contains` or `matches`. An unsupported `attribute`, a missing condition, or an unsafe regex causes the whole step to be skipped.

attribute.markdownDescription: Raw `span_attributes` key to inspect. Restricted to the forbidden-to-sync local-only content set (plus `copilot_chat.mode_name`). Any other key is rejected and the step is skipped.

contains.markdownDescription: Case-insensitive substring to look for. Preferred over `matches` for simple checks.

matches.markdownDescription: Regex pattern to test against the attribute value. A conservative ReDoS-safe subset is enforced: regex alternation `|` under a repetition (e.g. `(a|b)+`) and other catastrophic-backtracking shapes are rejected and the step is skipped — use a character class such as `[ab]+` instead. Regex matching runs only over the first 1,000 characters of the value (vs 10,000 for `contains`) to bound backtracking cost. Prefer `contains` for simple checks.

negate.markdownDescription: Invert the match (e.g. assert the content does NOT contain the value).

agentObservability.analysis.codeFileExte.markdownDescription: File extensions counted as **source code** (LoC / nLoC) on the local session-detail panel. Lines the agent writes to / removes from files with these extensions are tallied by reading each file-writing tool call's arguments. Classification is by extension only; files matching neither this nor `#agentObservability.analysis.docFileExtensions#` are ignored. Leading dots are optional and case is ignored. Computed entirely locally from raw tool arguments — nothing is ever uploaded.

agentObservability.analysis.docFileExten.markdownDescription: File extensions counted as **documentation** (LoD / nLoD) on the local session-detail panel. Lines the agent writes to / removes from files with these extensions are tallied by reading each file-writing tool call's arguments. Classification is by extension only; files matching neither this nor `#agentObservability.analysis.codeFileExtensions#` are ignored. Leading dots are optional and case is ignored. Computed entirely locally from raw tool arguments — nothing is ever uploaded.

agentObservability.liveUpdates.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable near-real-time live updates: tail the OpenTelemetry JSON-lines file written by GitHub Copilot Chat's `file` exporter and overlay a live status banner on the session-detail panel as an agent runs. Off by default. Use the **Agent Observability: Enable Live Updates (Copilot OTel)** command to turn this on — it also configures Copilot's `#github.copilot.chat.otel.enabled#` / `exporterType` / `outfile` settings. The file is read locally only; nothing is uploaded. The durable history view continues to read the SQLite database regardless of this setting.

agentObservability.liveUpdates.otelFileP.markdownDescription: Path to the OpenTelemetry JSON-lines file Copilot's `file` exporter writes (must match `#github.copilot.chat.otel.outfile#`). Leave blank to use the extension-managed default under its global storage. Set explicitly only if you point Copilot's exporter at a custom location.

agentObservability.liveUpdates.debounceM.markdownDescription: Coalescing window, in milliseconds, between detecting new spans in the OTel file and reading them. Lower feels more live but costs more frequent reads; minimum 100.
